name: Harem Racer ~Koi no Regulation Matta Nashi!~
original_name: ハーレムレーサー ～恋のレギュレーション待ったなし!～
source:
Hero is a racer of a Formula 1 team. He needs to train every day before the races, but at leisure time he can also pursue love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一支一级方程式赛车队的车手。赛前他每天都必须坚持训练，不过在闲暇时间里也可以追求爱情。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
